axioms.mathematical_meaning: Integrability of the literal floor/min/max outer integrand on the printed compact interval.
Absolute integrability of the literal inner R(x)/x^3 on (20,∞); no sign or constant bound.

coverage: Actual outer and inner real functions are defined verbatim; axioms cover regularity/convergence only. None of the three printed numeric/arithmetic conclusions is assumed.
repair_gate: Table arithmetic alone is not a partition proof. Audit floor endpoints, survivor classes and replacement ranges. Imported 5.4 only applies to simple pole pairs and cannot silently supply higher-order residue claims.
object_interface_work: Construct and verify the full floor-function interval partition, continuity claims and exact integration; derive a rigorous periodic-primitive tail majorant proving the signed inequality; build actual pole classes, ordered replacement polynomials, invertible local basis transformation and q-adic determinant valuation estimates.
discharge_obligations: Replace outerT_integrable by finite-piece regularity proof and inner_tail_integrable by a proved absolute majorant. These are deliberately weaker than the final integral value and inequality.
